title: Subagent findings
description: Output returned by the web-searcher and document-analyst subagents. Each finding keeps its content (the claim) separate from its metadata (where it came from and how much to trust it).

metadata.description: Run-level metadata. Says nothing about any single finding.

question.description: The subtask as received, in one sentence.

sources_consulted.description: Distinct URLs fetched or documents read.

gaps.description: What could not be found or verified. Empty array if none.

id.description: F1, F2, ... unique within one output. The synthesizer prefixes the input label (W1-F1) when pooling.

claim.description: One self-contained factual statement. Prefix with 'Interpretation: ' if it is an inference rather than something the source states.

source_url.description: URL of the web page. null for local documents.

document_name.description: Web: the page title exactly as published. Local: the file path.

page_number.description: Integer for one PDF page (12); string for a page range ("12-14") or a line reference in a file without pages ("L40-58"); null for web pages.

confidence.description: high: stated explicitly by an authoritative primary source, or corroborated by 2+ independent sources. medium: stated by one credible source, or a close reading needing minor interpretation. low: single non-authoritative source, outdated, inferred, or contradicted by another source.
